attribution: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, Application Technology Research Unit (Toledo, OH). Fact sheets 'Butterhead Lettuce - Nitrogen Deficiency' / '- Phosphorus Deficiency' (2011); contact Jonathan Frantz.
evidence: Both PDFs carry only USDA/ARS branding and an ARS employee contact (J. Frantz, jonathan.frantz@ars.usda.gov); no photographer byline, photo credit, (c) notice, contractor or university copyright line on any page (read in full: N 1 page, P 2 pages).
Cornell CEA Lettuce Handbook appears only as 'For Further Reference', not as an image credit.
Extracted embedded JPEGs carry no EXIF Artist/Copyright/ImageDescription fields and no XMP rights packet.
PDF document info: Creator Adobe InDesign CS5, Producer Adobe PDF Library 9.9, created 2011-11-21/22; no Author/Copyright/Rights keys.

USDA site policy (https://www.usda.gov/about-usda/policies-and-links, checked 2026-10-29): most USDA web information is public domain; copyrighted third-party material is used with permission and USDA 'has made every attempt to identify and clearly label them'. These sheets carry no such label.
residual_caveat: The sheets do not name who took the photographs. ARS ATRU worked with university collaborators; if a non-federal collaborator took a photo it would not be a federal work. No evidence of that exists - status rests on the absence of any notice plus USDA's labelling policy, not on positive photographer attribution.
